hero_kpi_rationale: The operating margin reflects Yara's ability to generate profit in a volatile fertilizer sector, impacted by energy costs and raw material prices.

kpis.explanation_en: Portion of revenue that remains after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: The gross margin is affected by the volatility of natural gas prices and nitrogen-based raw material costs.
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure due to energy costs and raw material prices.

kpis.explanation_en: Profit generated before taxes and other financial charges, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: The operating margin declined in 2023 due to lower fertilizer volumes and prices.
kpis.signal: Margin compression linked to a tight macroeconomic environment.

kpis.explanation_en: Portion of revenues invested in research and development.
kpis.description: Yara invests in agronomic innovation and precision farming technologies, including Yara Digital Farming with AI-based predictive models.
kpis.signal: R&D focused on low-carbon solutions and agricultural digitalization.

kpis.explanation_en: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand production capacity.
kpis.description: The 2023 capex includes green hydrogen projects and Scope 1 emissions reduction initiatives.
kpis.signal: Increased capex to strengthen energy resilience and decarbonize sites.

kpis.explanation_en: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Yara maintains a stable workforce while strengthening its digital and sustainability teams.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction in the context of operational optimization.

kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 22.0 NOK in the latest year.

kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.127 Bn NOK in the latest year.

kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 9.3% in the latest year.

kpis.explanation_en: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Indicates the company's ability to generate earnings per share: used as the basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

ai_positioning.summary: Yara adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, gradually integrating it into its agronomic tools and digital farming platforms. The focus is on input efficiency and sustainability rather than disruptive innovation.
evidence: Deployment of Yara Digital Farming with AI-based predictive models
Use of nitrogen application optimization algorithms
Regional partnerships to test data-driven agricultural solutions
